section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a single study where participants were randomly assigned to either a preexposed (n=57) or nonpreexposed (n=29) LI condition. During a pretest interview, demographic information was collected, and participants were screened for depression, anxiety, boredom, and recent alcohol/caffeine intake. Following this, all participants completed creativity measures, IQ tests, personality tests, and an LI task.
